title: Grateful Dead Live at Compton Terrace Amphitheatre on 1982-07-25
lineage: AUD> ?> DAT> CD> EAC> SHN> WAV> CE2K> CDWAVE> SHNTOOL> mkwACT

ai_review.summary: A solid ’82 Tempe show with a tight setlist, standout Crazy Fingers and Half‑Step moments, captured on a clear soundboard recording.
ai_review.review: The concert delivers a well‑selected, high‑energy performance that fans recall as “jammin” with happy Jerry Garcia and strong playing throughout. The soundboard source is described as fine to good and easy to listen to, making the show pleasant for repeated spins. While one reviewer finds it not quite legendary, the overall consensus points to a noteworthy representation of an 1982 Dead show.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews highlight strong musical performance and good sound quality; weighted rating (70% show, 30% recording) yields a high‑mid score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound described as fine to good and easy to listen; no major dropouts or muddiness reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set noted as solid, second set praised for its energy; overall a well‑chosen, representative ’82 setlist.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Happy vibe evident in his singing on Half Step; guitar work described as great and jam‑ready.
